title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 046
review_goal: Differentiate bowl, bridge, and briefcase variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Round bowl with three steam line curls rising above the rim
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a hot bowl with steam marks clearly rising above it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain bowl when no steam should appear above the rim.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds three steam curls above the same bowl shape.

items.depicts_observation: Suspension bridge frame with two towers one curved line cable above deck rails
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a suspension bridge with two towers and hanging cable lines.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the arched bridge when the main span should be a single arch over water.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows bridge towers, a curved suspension cable, and rail segments across the deck.

items.depicts_observation: Arched bridge with three top posts and two short water line marks below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an arched bridge silhouette over short water lines below.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the suspension bridge when two towers and hanging cables should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot simplifies the bridge into one arch with small posts and water marks underneath.

items.depicts_observation: Briefcase with a top handle lid stripe and one centered clasp dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a briefcase with a flat handle and one small clasp under the lid stripe.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the lock plate briefcase when the front should show an oval lock shape.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses a boxy briefcase with one top handle and one small clasp dot on the front.

items.depicts_observation: Briefcase with a half circle handle above one oval lock plate
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a briefcase with a rounded handle and an oval lock plate in front.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the clasp dot briefcase when the front closure should stay small and simple.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot rounds the handle and replaces the clasp dot with a larger oval lock plate.
